title: Permission Simulation & Safe Edit Flow for Role Editing
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Design the UI/UX for a safe role editing experience in Console that lets admins preview the effective permissions, simulate changes against real member lists and resources, and save edits as an auditable, undoable change. This ticket focuses on the editor surface, the permission impact simulation modal, and the member-assignment preview for RBAC v2.
background: Customers have asked for safer tools when editing roles: accidental privilege escalation is a top concern for enterprise admins. Currently the role editor is a flat permissions list and separate member assignment view — admins must mentally merge effects across multiple screens. RBAC v2 requires a single coherent flow that reduces mistakes, provides clear audit trails, and integrates with audit logging + SSO group mappings.
goals: Provide a low-risk role edit flow with a preview of effective permissions per member and per resource
Allow admins to simulate changes against current members and groups (including SSO-mapped groups) before saving
Surface likely downstream effects (e.g., access to production clusters, ability to change billing settings) to reduce accidental escalations
Produce artifacts compatible with audit logging and release notes (change summary and who approved)
Ensure accessibility and clarity for non-security-focused admins
design_decisions: Introduce a 'Simulate changes' CTA inside the role editor that opens a modal instead of an inline preview to avoid clutter
Show a side-by-side comparison: Current role permissions vs Proposed role permissions, with highlighted diffs and risk badges
Include a sample members table in the simulator that expands into per-member effective permission checks and example actions they would gain/lose
Make the edit a draft until explicitly 'Apply changes' — drafts are persisted and listed in Role -> Change history
Integrate a lightweight static analyzer that flags high-risk permission deltas and requires an extra confirmation for privileged grants (e.g., cluster-admin, billing:write)
Persist a compact change-summary string in audit logs and link to the full JSON diff for SRE/SEC teams
tradeoffs: Modal-based simulation keeps editor simple but adds a click — balanced by value of an explicit safety check
Per-member simulation requires sampling for very large orgs — initial implementation will show top 200 members and an extrapolated summary for >200
Static risk flags will intentionally be conservative to reduce false negatives; may generate more prompts for admins
Storing drafts increases complexity for sync across Dedicated/Private deployments; initial scope limits drafts to Console control plane only
acceptance_criteria: Role editor contains a visible 'Simulate changes' button when permissions are modified
Simulation modal shows a clear diff with risk badges and example resources affected
Simulation can be run against SSO-mapped groups and shows per-group impact
Admins can persist a draft change and later apply it; applying writes an entry to the audit log with a change summary
Designs include mobile-responsive layouts and meet WCAG AA contrast and keyboard navigation requirements
Design handoff includes Figma frames, a component list, and interaction specs for engineering
tasks: Finalize Figma flows for editor -> simulate modal -> apply draft
Create high-fidelity mocks for diff view and per-member expansion
Define copy for risk badges, confirmation dialogs, and audit log entry
Work with Security/SD to define the static risk rules list
Handoff: produce component tokens and accessibility checklist for frontend
Coordinate with ENG on pagination strategy for large org member simulations
dependencies: ENG-4122 (audit-log: append change-summary on role save)
PM-521 (SSO group sync behavior and group metadata surfaced to Console)
DES-15911 (visual tokens: diff highlight and risk badge components)
mockups: Editor main: compact permissions list with 'Simulate changes' CTA
Simulate modal: side-by-side diff, top risks, member sample table, 'Show more' for large results
Draft manager: list of saved drafts with timestamp, creator, and 'Apply / Discard' actions
Confirmation flow: escalate confirmation for high-risk grants with 'Require additional approver' checkbox
